assertions: Every successful content mutation advances a distinct content generation, primary and recovery saves acknowledge only completed writes, and Undo or Redo restores modified state relative to the last save mark.

stackDivergence.rationale: LibreOffice uses modified flags, an undo save mark, and an autosave-dirty timestamp; the browser model adds explicit generations so asynchronous IndexedDB recovery writes cannot miss consecutive dirty mutations.

records.capability: Writer document lifecycle separates content, primary-save, and recovery generations with LibreOffice-like modified and undo save-mark semantics
gaps: The current browser workbench has explicit local save and a deterministic recovery coordinator, but scheduled autosave and recovery-session UI are not yet wired into the Writer lifecycle.

The generation counters are a browser-specific concurrency aid; LibreOffice upstream represents equivalent save and recovery decisions through modified flags, an undo save mark, and recovery dirty-state bookkeeping.
